name: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy on Electricity Duty
benefit:
- Reimbursement equivalent to 100% of the electricity duty paid on High Tension electricity connections procured from the State's power distribution department.
- This reimbursement is subject to a ceiling of ₹5,00,000/- (Indian Rupees Five Lakhs) per unit per year.

##### ***Disbursal***

- The reimbursement pertains exclusively to the electricity duty component paid within the total electric
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be operating a Cold Chain Unit. - The applicant must be seeking reimbursement for electricity duty paid on High Tension (HT) electricity connections procured from the State's power distribution department. - The applicant must be applicable only for non-mega industries. - The applicant must own a business unit in Goa and provide Logistics And Warehousing services in Goa. - The applicant must be a Logistics And Warehousing services provider. - The applicant must have a Permanent Account Number (PAN) and should regularly file the Income Tax Returns in the name of the legal entity. - The applicant must be a new or existing entity that involves expansion or diversification, contingent upon compliance with all other conditions specified in this policy. - The applicant must be in continuous operations for a minimum period of six months post the date of notification of Logistics And Warehousing Policy, 2023. - The applicant must have incurred the expenses (electricity duty paid) post the date of launch of the Logistics And Warehousing Policy, 2023,. - The applicant must not have claimed a similar benefit under any other scheme/program of State or Central Government. - The applicant must provide a minimum of 40% local employment (employees who are employed continuously during the claim year and are on the payroll of the unit for that year shall be considered). ****The benefits under this scheme are subject to first come first serve basis subject to availability of funds in a particular fiscal year.***
